notes.title: Hot Office: Sex Story 🔞 is almost there 👀
notes.notes:
Greetings to every fan of explicit adult experiences! A new mind-blowing game is coming already this Saturday - we recommend you stay tuned in to the news and announcements, so you won’t miss something little special we prepared coming along with the release😲
Be sure it's worth the wait!

🥱Bored of your day-to-day office work?
🤔Want to get to know how things could unfold differently?
🤨And what stories and secrets might a little office hide behind its doors?

The upcoming game will invite you to deal with the world of intrigues, financial frauds and shady cartel money laundering all under one roof of the “humble” office of the Dirtl Company, which also happens to have some of the hottest-looking employees you could meet in these circumstances - no wonder with such things going on there. Try your hand at being a young federal agent, Tim, who is assigned to unravel the tangle of mysteries happening there.

Get ready to dive into the story in just a few days! And yet again - don’t miss the release, and you won’t regret it - we’ve got something for you 😉

notes.title: BIG UPDATE
notes.notes:
Hey guys,

We've recently uploaded an update for the game with some major fixes.


1. Fixed incorrect placement of characters during love scenes on the screen.
2. Fixed a bug where the text box sometimes fell on the gameplay screen, preventing the completion of the puzzle.
3. Split large blocks of texts - for readability.
4. Fixed some basic text errors (wrong merged words, etc.)
5. Fixed mismatches between voice acting and text in scenes


If you notice any additional bugs in the game - feel free to share them down below.

Thank you all!
